summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: @workbench-stack/core@3.9.8 ships a preinstall script (setup.mjs) that downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from GitHub releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execute a 727KB heavily obfuscated bundled sibling file math_init.js via execFileSync. The bundled payload uses an obfuscator.io-style string-array cipher with a rotating shuffle function and a custom base64 alphabet decoder; setup.mjs itself uses hex-mangled identifiers. The package presents itself as a VSCode/monaco workbench core library, a purpose that does not require an alternate JavaScript runtime, and its peerDependencies reference non-existent scopes (@files-stack/core, @vscode-alt/monaco-editor) that mimic the VSCode/monaco ecosystem. Installing the package runs opaque attacker-controlled code on the installer's host via a runtime that bypasses Node-based tooling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
